input.command:
set -e -o pipefail
for f in README.md backlog.md ceo-items.md decision-D7.md CEO-TODOs.md .ceo-todos; do printf '\n===== %s =====\n' "$f"; cat "$f"; done

input.description: wait for engineer to produce diagnosis.json
input.command:
set -e -o pipefail
for i in $(seq 1 600); do
  if [ -s diagnosis.json ]; then echo "diagnosis.json present"; exit 0; fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "timeout waiting for diagnosis.json"

set -e -o pipefail
python3 -m json.tool diagnosis.json > /dev/null && echo "diagnosis.json: VALID JSON" && python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('diagnosis.json'))
print('top-level keys:', sorted(d.keys()))
print('native  =', repr(d['native']), '| plain string:', isinstance(d['native'], str))
print('external=', repr(d['external']), '| plain string:', isinstance(d['external'], str))
print('evidence is separate object:', isinstance(d['evidence'], dict))
ok={'obsolete_assertion','implementation_defect'}
print('values in allowed set:', d['native'] in ok and d['external'] in ok)
"
